issue.title: (OPT) Retain independently derived renewal directories across ordinary construction and replay
issue.body:
Current source discovery at 5c39cadd9 found repeated whole-function renewal reconstruction: hir::vec_loop_renewal::binding_in calls bindings_in(...).remove(at), and bindings_in collects all ordinary + consuming sites. PlanBuilder::renewal_binding holds only byte-helper sites and takes this fresh route; ordinary cleanup replay asks renewal_profile::binding_with_index again for the same site. SkeletonWork already independently owns a renewal directory. This is distinct from the completed Bytes helper ModuleIndex.

Retain one ordinary RenewalBindings directory per actual construction/replay phase, independently derived from exact current program/function pointers. Preserve family selection priority and per-family membership: schema gating cannot use union membership alone. Selected primitive receiver authority remains separate. Reuse directory lookups without rescanning/rebuilding maps per occurrence; precharge actual held backing/work before allocation and preserve sticky first refusal and Drop.

Acceptance: saved old per-query classification vs phase-held directory across ordinary/owned/consuming families and opposing identity orders; malformed/stale/source-pointer/family-schema controls; exact/one-short/no-refund/Drop for actual constructor and replay; unchanged cleanup inventory/order and whole original application controls. No guessed quota/forecast discount or skipped validation. This is real repeated work but is NOT evidence identifying the earlier HirLowering 10280-byte refusal, which occurs in another phase. No application-fit or live agent token advantage claimed. Implement then minimum owning checks in the large release-branch batch.
